semiconductor_relevance: Low — JIBB primarily facilitates business connections and partnerships between Japan and India rather than directly engaging in semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: The Japan India Business Bureau (JIBB) connects businesses, governments, and academia across Japan and India to foster bilateral growth. They focus on market entry, partnerships, and innovation collaboration, which may indirectly support the semiconductor industry through business matching and cross-border initiatives.

regional_presence.Japan: JIBB operates to enhance business relations and partnerships in Japan.
regional_presence.India: JIBB facilitates market entry and collaboration opportunities in India.
